alerts.soundHint: Plays once for reminders and alarms that make a sound.
alerts.soundFileHint: Pick a sound on this PC, for example an MP3 or WAV file. It plays once, and the Stop button on the alert ends it.
alerts.followWindows: Stay quiet during Do not disturb
alerts.followWindowsHint: While Windows is on Do not disturb, alerts wait in Missed alerts. Alarms still show.
alerts.stopHint: Stop the sound and close this alert
